notes:
REF-BM-04: Title, description, tags, and note are editable, but the URL cannot be changed.
REF-BM-14: Search treats #tag as ordinary text and implements no tag-query syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized search expressions are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-phrase handling.
REF-BM-20: Multi-selection supports adding tags, read/unread, archive, and deletion, but not removing tags.
REF-BM-21: There is no action targeting every bookmark in the current filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Notes support sanitized rich HTML, not Markdown authoring and rendering.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot integration exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved search/tag bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display preferences are neither configurable as personal settings nor persisted.
